title: Bharadwaja arranges a befitting hospitality to Bharata
introduction: Having been instructed by Bharadwaja to bring the army to his place, Bharata allowed his army also to come to the hermitage. Then, Bharadwaja invokes Visvakarma, the divine architect and requests him to arrange for a befitting hopsitality to Bharata,
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकनवतितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 91st Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
कृत बुद्धिम् निवासाय तथैव स मुनिः तदा |
भरतम् कैकयी पुत्रम् आतिथ्येन न्यमन्त्रयत्
verses.iast:
kṛta buddhim nivāsāya tathaiva sa muniḥ tadā |
bharatam kaikayī putram ātithyena nyamantrayat
verses.translation: Seeing he had resolved to halt at that place for the night, the sage Bharadwaja prepared to offer Bharata the son of Kaikeyi the full honours due to a guest

glosses.meaning: the full honours due to a guest.

verses.devanagari:
अब्रवीद् भरतः तु एनम् ननु इदम् भवता कृतम् |
पाद्यम् अर्घ्यम् तथा आतिथ्यम् वने यद् ऊपपद्यते
verses.iast:
abravīd bharataḥ tu enam nanu idam bhavatā kṛtam |
pādyam arghyam tathā ātithyam vane yad ūpapadyate
verses.translation: Then, Bharata said to Bharadwaja as follows: "Have you not presented me with water to wash my hands and feet and offered me this hospitality fitting for a guest in this forest?"

glosses.meaning: this hositality fitting for a guest
in a forest (was made available to me).

verses.devanagari:
अथ उवाच भरद्वाजो भरतम् प्रहसन्न् इव |
जाने त्वाम् प्रीति सम्युक्तम् तुष्येः त्वम् येन केनचित्
verses.iast:
atha uvāca bharadvājo bharatam prahasann iva |
jāne tvām prīti samyuktam tuṣyeḥ tvam yena kenacit
verses.translation: Then, Bharadwaja smilingly replied to Bharata as follows: "I know you possess a friendly disposition and you are pleased with whatever is offered to you."

glosses.meaning: with whatever is offered to you.

verses.devanagari:
सेनायाः तु तव एतस्याः कर्तुम् इग्च्छामि भोजनम् |
मम प्रितिर् यथा रूपा त्वम् अर्हो मनुज ऋषभ
verses.iast:
senāyāḥ tu tava etasyāḥ kartum igcchāmi bhojanam |
mama pritir yathā rūpā tvam arho manuja ṛṣabha
verses.translation: "O, Bharata the excellent among men! I wish to offer food to your army. You ought to fulfil my satisfaction in every suitable way."

glosses.meaning: O the excellent among men!ichchhami = I wish

verses.devanagari:
किम् अर्थम् च अपि निक्षिप्य दूरे बलम् इह आगतः |
कस्मान् न इह उपयातो असि सबलः पुरुष ऋषभ
verses.iast:
kim artham ca api nikṣipya dūre balam iha āgataḥ |
kasmān na iha upayāto asi sabalaḥ puruṣa ṛṣabha
verses.translation: "O, warrior! Why did you come here, leaving your army at a distance? Why did you not come to my place with your army?"

verses.devanagari:
भरतः प्रत्युवाच इदम् प्रान्जलिः तम् तपो धनम् |
ससैन्यो न उपयातो अस्मि भगवन् भगवद् भयात्
verses.iast:
bharataḥ pratyuvāca idam prānjaliḥ tam tapo dhanam |
sasainyo na upayāto asmi bhagavan bhagavad bhayāt
verses.translation: Bharata, with joined palms, replied to Bharadwaja who was rich with austerity in the following words: "O, venerable one! I have not come here with my army for the fear of displeasing you."

verses.devanagari:
राज्ञा च भगवन्नित्यं राजपुत्रेण वा सदा |
यत्नतः परिहर्तव्या विषयेषु तपस्विनः
verses.iast:
rājJṇā ca bhagavannityaṃ rājaputreṇa vā sadā |
yatnataḥ parihartavyā viṣayeṣu tapasvinaḥ
verses.translation: "O, Venerable One! Either the king or the prince should always keep away from the places occupied by ascetics"

glosses.meaning: are to be kept away at a distance

verses.devanagari:
वाजि मुख्या मनुष्याः च मत्ताः च वर वारणाः |
प्रग्च्छाद्य महतीम् भूमिम् भगवन्न् अनुयान्ति माम्
verses.iast:
vāji mukhyā manuṣyāḥ ca mattāḥ ca vara vāraṇāḥ |
pragcchādya mahatīm bhūmim bhagavann anuyānti mām
verses.translation: "O, Holy one! Spirited horses, men and rare elephants in rut covering an immense area are accompanying me."

verses.devanagari:
ते वृक्षान् उदकम् भूमिम् आश्रमेषु उटजामः तथा |
न हिंस्युर् इति तेन अहम् एक एव आगतः ततः
verses.iast:
te vṛkṣān udakam bhūmim āśrameṣu uṭajāmḥ tathā |
na hiṃsyur iti tena aham eka eva āgataḥ tataḥ
verses.translation: "Let them not damage the trees, huts and ground and defile the waters of hermitages' - in this thought, I came alone."

verses.devanagari:
आनीयताम् इतः सेना इत्य् आज्नप्तः परम ऋषिणा |
तथा तु चक्रे भरतः सेनायाः समुपागमम्
verses.iast:
ānīyatām itaḥ senā ity ājnaptaḥ parama ṛṣiṇā |
tathā tu cakre bharataḥ senāyāḥ samupāgamam
verses.translation: Thereafter Bharata, having been commanded by that great sage to bring the army there, allowed the army's arrival to the hermitage.

verses.devanagari:
अग्नि शालाम् प्रविश्य अथ पीत्वा अपः परिमृज्य च |
आतिथ्यस्य क्रिया हेतोर् विश्व कर्माणम् आह्वयत्
verses.iast:
agni śālām praviśya atha pītvā apaḥ parimṛjya ca |
ātithyasya kriyā hetor viśva karmāṇam āhvayat
verses.translation: Meanwhile, entering the fire-sanctuary (the place where the sacrificial fire is kept), sipping water and wiping the lips, Bharadwaja invoked Visvakarma (the architect of gods) in order to fulfil his duties towards the guests (as follows)

glosses.meaning: the fire-sanctuary (the place where the sacrificial fire is kept)
and in order to fulfil his duties

verses.devanagari:
आह्वये विश्व कर्माणम् अहम् त्वष्टारम् एव च |
आतिथ्यम् कर्तुम् इग्च्छामि तत्र मे सम्विधीयताम्
verses.iast:
āhvaye viśva karmāṇam aham tvaṣṭāram eva ca |
ātithyam kartum igcchāmi tatra me samvidhīyatām
verses.translation: "I wish to offer hospitality to the guest I summon vishvakarma who is also the divine carpenter. Let arrangements be made in that connection for me."

glosses.meaning: who is also the divine carpenter

verses.devanagari:
अह्वये लोकपालां स्त्रीन् देवान् शक्रमुखांस्तथा |
आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्चामि तत्र मे संविधीयताम्
verses.iast:
ahvaye lokapālāṃ strīn devān śakramukhāṃstathā |
ātithyaṃ kartumiccāmi tatra me saṃvidhīyatām
verses.translation: "I further invoke the three gods (Yama, Varuna and Kubera) the guardians of the worlds with Indra as their king. I wish to offer hospitality to the guests. Let arrangements be made in this connection for me."

verses.devanagari:
प्राक् स्रोतसः च या नद्यः प्रत्यक् स्रोतस एव च |
पृथिव्याम् अन्तरिक्षे च समायान्तु अद्य सर्वशः
verses.iast:
prāk srotasaḥ ca yā nadyaḥ pratyak srotasa eva ca |
pṛthivyām antarikṣe ca samāyāntu adya sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: "Let the rivers which flow towards the east and those which flow towards the west, across the earth and in the aerial region now come together here from all quarters."

glosses.meaning: and those which flow towards the west

verses.devanagari:
अन्याः स्रवन्तु मैरेयम् सुराम् अन्याः सुनिष्ठिताम् |
अपराः च उदकम् शीतम् इक्षु काण्ड रस उपमम्
verses.iast:
anyāḥ sravantu maireyam surām anyāḥ suniṣṭhitām |
aparāḥ ca udakam śītam ikṣu kāṇḍa rasa upamam
verses.translation: "Let some rivers flow with Maireya ( a kind of wine made from date palms etc) some others flow with highly refined spirituous liquor and some others flow with cool water with a taste of sugarcane."

glosses.meaning: Maireya ( a kind of wine made from date palms etc)
and some others (flow with) suniSThitaam = highly
with a taste of sugar cane.

verses.devanagari:
आह्वये देव गन्धर्वान् विश्वा वसु हहा हुहून् |
तथैव अप्सरसो देवीर् गन्धर्वीः च अपि सर्वशः
verses.iast:
āhvaye deva gandharvān viśvā vasu hahā huhūn |
tathaiva apsaraso devīr gandharvīḥ ca api sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: "I invoke the celestials and celestial musicians Vishvavasu, Haha and Huhu as also Apsaras (nymphs) belonging to the celestial and celestial musicians' race from all regions.

glosses.meaning: and also belonging to celestial musicians race sarvashaH = from all regions.

verses.devanagari:
घृताचीम् अथ विश्वाचीम् मिश्र केशीम् अलम्बुसाम् |
नागदन्तां च हेमां च हिमामद्रिकृतस्थलाम्
verses.iast:
ghṛtācīm atha viśvācīm miśra keśīm alambusām |
nāgadantāṃ ca hemāṃ ca himāmadrikṛtasthalām
verses.translation: "I invoke the celestial nymphs called ghritachi, Vishvachi, Mishra Kesi, Alambusa, Nagadanta and Hema as also Hima who has an abode made in mountains."

glosses.meaning: who has an abode made in mountains.

verses.devanagari:
शक्रम् याः च उपतिष्ठन्ति ब्रह्माणम् याः च भामिनीः |
सर्वाः तुम्बुरुणा सार्धम् आह्वये सपरिग्च्छदाः
verses.iast:
śakram yāḥ ca upatiṣṭhanti brahmāṇam yāḥ ca bhāminīḥ |
sarvāḥ tumburuṇā sārdham āhvaye saparigcchadāḥ
verses.translation: "I invoke the fair women who are attending on Brahma the Lord of creation - all of them with their external appendages (like musical instruments) along with (their teacher) Tumburu."

glosses.meaning: and those who are (are attending on)
with their external appendages (like musical instruments)

verses.devanagari:
वनम् कुरुषु यद् दिव्यम् वासो भूषण पत्रवत् |
दिव्य नारी फलम् शश्वत् तत् कौबेरम् इह एव तु
verses.iast:
vanam kuruṣu yad divyam vāso bhūṣaṇa patravat |
divya nārī phalam śaśvat tat kauberam iha eva tu
verses.translation: "Let that beautiful garden in the region of northern Kuru, presided over by Kubera (the god of riches) always with its leaves which serve as raiment and ornaments, with its fruits in the form of heavenly damsels appear in this place."

glosses.meaning: in the region of northern Kuru
with its fruits in the form of heavenly damsels

verses.devanagari:
इह मे भगवान् सोमो विधत्ताम् अन्नम् उत्तमम् |
भक्ष्यम् भोज्यम् च चोष्यम् च लेह्यम् च विविधम् बहु
verses.iast:
iha me bhagavān somo vidhattām annam uttamam |
bhakṣyam bhojyam ca coṣyam ca lehyam ca vividham bahu
verses.translation: "Many the blessed moon-god (the duty presiding over annual plants) furnish me at this place, excellent food of every variety, confections, sweets, sauces and syrups."

glosses.meaning: moon god( the deity presiding over annual plants)

verses.devanagari:
विचित्राणि च माल्यानि पादप प्रच्युतानि च |
सुरा आदीनि च पेयानि मांसानि विविधानि च
verses.iast:
vicitrāṇi ca mālyāni pādapa pracyutāni ca |
surā ādīni ca peyāni māṃsāni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: "May the blessed moon-god furnish me many-coloured flowers which have just fallen from the flower-plants or trees, the drinks like wine and others as also various kinds of meat."

glosses.meaning: which have just fallen from trees

verses.devanagari:
एवम् समाधिना युक्तः तेजसा अप्रतिमेन च |
शिक्षा स्वर समायुक्तम् तपसा च अब्रवीन् मुनिः
verses.iast:
evam samādhinā yuktaḥ tejasā apratimena ca |
śikṣā svara samāyuktam tapasā ca abravīn muniḥ
verses.translation: That sage Bharadwaja, with his intense meditation, possessing unequal splendour and with austerity, spoke as follows, in tones befitting proper articulation and pronunciation of the scriptural texts:

glosses.meaning: in tones according to the science which deals with proper articulation and pronunciation of Vedic texts.

verses.devanagari:
मनसा ध्यायतः तस्य प्रान् मुखस्य कृत अन्जलेः |
आजग्मुः तानि सर्वाणि दैवतानि पृथक् पृथक्
verses.iast:
manasā dhyāyataḥ tasya prān mukhasya kṛta anjaleḥ |
ājagmuḥ tāni sarvāṇi daivatāni pṛthak pṛthak
verses.translation: While that sage Bharadwaja, with joined palms, was meditating with absorption in the east, all those celestials came one by one.

glosses.meaning: turning his face towards the east

verses.devanagari:
मलयम् दुर्दुरम् चैव ततः स्वेद नुदो अनिलः |
उपस्पृश्य ववौ युक्त्या सुप्रिय आत्मा सुखः शिवः
verses.iast:
malayam durduram caiva tataḥ sveda nudo anilaḥ |
upaspṛśya vavau yuktyā supriya ātmā sukhaḥ śivaḥ
verses.translation: Then, a pleasant comfortable and gracious breeze, passing over the mountains of Malaya and Dardura, began to blw, removing sweat by its influence.

verses.devanagari:
ततो अभ्यवर्तन्त घना दिव्याः कुसुम वृष्टयः |
देव दुन्दुभि घोषः च दिक्षु सर्वासु शुश्रुवे
verses.iast:
tato abhyavartanta ghanā divyāḥ kusuma vṛṣṭayaḥ |
deva dundubhi ghoṣaḥ ca dikṣu sarvāsu śuśruve
verses.translation: Thereafter wonderful clouds let loose a rain of flowers, while the sound of divine gongs could be heard on every side.

glosses.meaning: while the sound of divine gongs

verses.devanagari:
प्रववुः च उत्तमा वाता ननृतुः च अप्सरो गणाः |
प्रजगुर् देव गन्धर्वा वीणा प्रमुमुचुः स्वरान्
verses.iast:
pravavuḥ ca uttamā vātā nanṛtuḥ ca apsaro gaṇāḥ |
prajagur deva gandharvā vīṇā pramumucuḥ svarān
verses.translation: Troops of Apsaras (divine nymphs) danced to the melodious rustling of the wind. The clestials and the celestial musicians sang. Vinas, stringed musical instruments transmitted their tunes.

verses.devanagari:
स शब्दो द्याम् च भूमिम् च प्राणिनाम् श्रवणानि च |
विवेश उच्चारितः श्लक्ष्णः समो लय गुण अन्वितः
verses.iast:
sa śabdo dyām ca bhūmim ca prāṇinām śravaṇāni ca |
viveśa uccāritaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ samo laya guṇa anvitaḥ
verses.translation: Sweat and harmonious sounds emitted smoothly, entered the sky earth and the ears of beings.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन्न् उपरते शब्दे दिव्ये श्रोत्र सुखे नृणाम् |
ददर्श भारतम् सैन्यम् विधानम् विश्व कर्मणः
verses.iast:
tasminn uparate śabde divye śrotra sukhe nṛṇām |
dadarśa bhāratam sainyam vidhānam viśva karmaṇaḥ
verses.translation: When those celestial melodies ceased so pleasingly heard by the human ears, Bharata's army saw the wonderful creations of Visvakarma.

verses.devanagari:
बभूव हि समा भूमिः समन्तात् पन्च योजनम् |
शाद्वलैर् बहुभिः चन्ना नील वैदूर्य सम्निभैः
verses.iast:
babhūva hi samā bhūmiḥ samantāt panca yojanam |
śādvalair bahubhiḥ cannā nīla vaidūrya samnibhaiḥ
verses.translation: A levelled land of approximately twenty miles on all sides, became covered by many carpets of grass, dark as emerald.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् बिल्वाः कपित्थाः च पनसा बीज पूरकाः |
आमलक्यो बभूवुः च चूताः च फल भूषणाः
verses.iast:
tasmin bilvāḥ kapitthāḥ ca panasā bīja pūrakāḥ |
āmalakyo babhūvuḥ ca cūtāḥ ca phala bhūṣaṇāḥ
verses.translation: At that place, Bilva, Kapittha, Panasa, Citron Amalaki and Mango Trees laden with fruit appeared.

verses.devanagari:
उत्तरेभ्यः कुरुभ्यः च वनम् दिव्य उपभोगवत् |
आजगाम नदी दिव्या तीरजैर् बहुभिर् वृता
verses.iast:
uttarebhyaḥ kurubhyaḥ ca vanam divya upabhogavat |
ājagāma nadī divyā tīrajair bahubhir vṛtā
verses.translation: A forest of divine enjoyments from the territory of northern Kuru's along with a river shaped with various trees on its bank appeared there.

glosses.meaning: from the tearitory of northern Kuru's

verses.devanagari:
चतुः शालानि शुभ्राणि शालाः च गज वाजिनाम् |
हर्म्य प्रासाद सम्घाताः तोरणानि शुभानि च
verses.iast:
catuḥ śālāni śubhrāṇi śālāḥ ca gaja vājinām |
harmya prāsāda samghātāḥ toraṇāni śubhāni ca
verses.translation: Splendid square mansions with stables for elephants and horses as well as resplendent gates with watch-towers flanked by turrets were seen.

glosses.meaning: gates with watch-towers flanked by turrets (could be seen).

verses.devanagari:
सित मेघ निभम् च अपि राज वेश्म सुतोरणम् |
शुक्ल माल्य कृत आकारम् दिव्य गन्ध समुक्षितम्
चतुर् अस्रम् असम्बाधम् शयन आसन यानवत् |
दिव्यैः सर्व रसैर् युक्तम् दिव्य भोजन वस्त्रवत्
उपकल्पित सर्व अन्नम् धौत निर्मल भाजनम् |
क्लृप्त सर्व आसनम् श्रीमत् स्वास्तीर्ण शयन उत्तमम्
verses.iast:
sita megha nibham ca api rāja veśma sutoraṇam |
śukla mālya kṛta ākāram divya gandha samukṣitam
catur asram asambādham śayana āsana yānavat |
divyaiḥ sarva rasair yuktam divya bhojana vastravat
upakalpita sarva annam dhauta nirmala bhājanam |
klṛpta sarva āsanam śrīmat svāstīrṇa śayana uttamam
verses.translation: A royal palace emerged, dazzling as a cloud, pierced by splendid arches, hung with white garlands, filled with fragrance of celestial perfumes, forming a perfect quadrangle, spacious, furnished with couches seats and palanquins, supplied with ambrosial drinks of every kind as well as magnificent attire and food of every variety, well-prepared eatables of every description in cleaned vessels free from dirt and all kinds of seats arranged in order looked charming with superb couches duly covered with rich carpets.

glosses.meaning: filled with fragrance of celestial perfumes
magnificent attire and food of every variety
in cleaned vessels free from dirt
all kinds of seats arranged in order
with superb couches duly covered with rich carpets

verses.devanagari:
प्रविवेश महा बाहुर् अनुज्नातो महर्षिणा |
वेश्म तद् रत्न सम्पूर्णम् भरतः कैकयी सुतः
verses.iast:
praviveśa mahā bāhur anujnāto maharṣiṇā |
veśma tad ratna sampūrṇam bharataḥ kaikayī sutaḥ
verses.translation: The mighty armed Bharata the son of Kaikeyi on invitation by the great sage, entered that palace filled with precious gems.

verses.devanagari:
अनुजग्मुः च तम् सर्वे मन्त्रिणः सपुरोहिताः |
बभूवुः च मुदा युक्ता तम् दृष्ट्वा वेश्म सम्विधिम्
verses.iast:
anujagmuḥ ca tam sarve mantriṇaḥ sapurohitāḥ |
babhūvuḥ ca mudā yuktā tam dṛṣṭvā veśma samvidhim
verses.translation: All the ministers together with priests accompanied Bharata and on entering that excellent get-up of the house, were filled with delight

verses.devanagari:
तत्र राज आसनम् दिव्यम् व्यजनम् चत्रम् एव च |
भरतो मन्त्रिभिः सार्धम् अभ्यवर्तत राजवत्
verses.iast:
tatra rāja āsanam divyam vyajanam catram eva ca |
bharato mantribhiḥ sārdham abhyavartata rājavat
verses.translation: Bharata along with his ministers went clock-wise round the excellent royal throne, whisk and the royal umbrella kept there, as if they were utilized by a king.

glosses.meaning: as if they were utilized by a king.

verses.devanagari:
आसनम् पूजयाम् आस रामाय अभिप्रणम्य च |
वाल व्यजनम् आदाय न्यषीदत् सचिव आसने
verses.iast:
āsanam pūjayām āsa rāmāya abhipraṇamya ca |
vāla vyajanam ādāya nyaṣīdat saciva āsane
verses.translation: They paid reverence to the royal seat, bowing before it, as if Rama sat thereon and thereafter Bharata, taking hold of the whisk, sat down on the seat meant for the chief minister.

glosses.meaning: on the seat meant for the chief minister.

verses.devanagari:
आनुपूर्व्यान् निषेदुः च सर्वे मन्त्र पुरोहिताः |
ततः सेना पतिः पश्चात् प्रशास्ता च निषेदतुः
verses.iast:
ānupūrvyān niṣeduḥ ca sarve mantra purohitāḥ |
tataḥ senā patiḥ paścāt praśāstā ca niṣedatuḥ
verses.translation: All the ministers and priests sat down in order of precedence. Thereafter, the chief of the army and at last the officer-in-charge of the encampment occupied their seats.

verses.devanagari:
ततः तत्र मुहूर्तेन नद्यः पायस कर्दमाः |
उपातिष्ठन्त भरतम् भरद्वाजस्य शासनत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tatra muhūrtena nadyaḥ pāyasa kardamāḥ |
upātiṣṭhanta bharatam bharadvājasya śāsanat
verses.translation: Then, on an instant, by the orders of Bharadwaja, streams having milk thickened with rice in the place of mud, flowed towards Bharata.

glosses.meaning: having milk thickened with rice in the plce of mud

verses.devanagari:
तासाम् उभयतः कूलम् पाण्डु मृत्तिक लेपनाः |
रम्याः च आवसथा दिव्या ब्रह्मणः तु प्रसादजाः
verses.iast:
tāsām ubhayataḥ kūlam pāṇḍu mṛttika lepanāḥ |
ramyāḥ ca āvasathā divyā brahmaṇaḥ tu prasādajāḥ
verses.translation: On both the banks of those streams, enchanting and celestial houses plastered with white clay born out of the grace of Brahma the Lord of creation, appeared.

glosses.meaning: of Brahma the Lord of creation

verses.devanagari:
तेन एव च मुहूर्तेन दिव्य आभरण भूषिताः |
आगुर् विंशति साहस्राः ब्राह्मणा प्रहिताः स्त्रियः
verses.iast:
tena eva ca muhūrtena divya ābharaṇa bhūṣitāḥ |
āgur viṃśati sāhasrāḥ brāhmaṇā prahitāḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: At that moment itself, twenty thousand women adorned with beautiful ornaments, sent by Brahma, arrived.

verses.devanagari:
सुवर्ण मणि मुक्तेन प्रवालेन च शोभिताः |
आगुर् विंशति साहस्राः कुबेर प्रहिताः स्त्रियः
verses.iast:
suvarṇa maṇi muktena pravālena ca śobhitāḥ |
āgur viṃśati sāhasrāḥ kubera prahitāḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: Twenty thousand more women, who were radiant and adorned with gold, gems, pearls and corals came from the region of Kubera.

verses.devanagari:
याभिर् गृहीतः पुरुषः स उन्माद इव लक्ष्यते |
आगुर् विंशति साहस्रा नन्दनाद् अप्सरो गणाः
verses.iast:
yābhir gṛhītaḥ puruṣaḥ sa unmāda iva lakṣyate |
āgur viṃśati sāhasrā nandanād apsaro gaṇāḥ
verses.translation: A particular company of Apsaras, embraced by whom, a man looked as though seized with insanity, came from Nandana grove.

verses.devanagari:
नारदः तुम्बुरुर् गोपः पर्वतः सूर्य वर्चसः |
एते गन्धर्व राजानो भरतस्य अग्रतो जगुः
verses.iast:
nāradaḥ tumburur gopaḥ parvataḥ sūrya varcasaḥ |
ete gandharva rājāno bharatasya agrato jaguḥ
verses.translation: Those most excellent kings among celestial musicians - Narada, Tumbura and Gopa whose radiance is like that of the sun, began to sing in front of Bharata.

glosses.meaning: whose radiance is like that of the sun

verses.devanagari:
अलम्बुसा मिश्र केशी पुण्डरीका अथ वामना |
उपानृत्यमः तु भरतम् भरद्वाजस्य शासनात्
verses.iast:
alambusā miśra keśī puṇḍarīkā atha vāmanā |
upānṛtyamḥ tu bharatam bharadvājasya śāsanāt
verses.translation: Then, on the command of Bharadwaja, Alambusa, MishraKesi and Vamana started dancing in the presence of Bharata.

verses.devanagari:
यानि माल्यानि देवेषु यानि चैत्ररथे वने |
प्रयागे तान्य् अदृश्यन्त भरद्वाजस्य शासनात्
verses.iast:
yāni mālyāni deveṣu yāni caitrarathe vane |
prayāge tāny adṛśyanta bharadvājasya śāsanāt
verses.translation: By the command of Bharadwaja, wreaths of flowers which were beloved of the gods or those which grow in the woods of chaitra ratha were seen at Prayaga.

verses.devanagari:
बिल्वा मार्दन्गिका आसन् शम्या ग्राहा बिभीतकाः |
अश्वत्था नर्तकाः च आसन् भरद्वाजस्य तेजसा
verses.iast:
bilvā mārdangikā āsan śamyā grāhā bibhītakāḥ |
aśvatthā nartakāḥ ca āsan bharadvājasya tejasā
verses.translation: By the command of Bharadwaja, Bel trees assumed the form of drummers, Vibhitaka trees assumed the form of cymbalists and Peepul trees assumed the form of dancers.

verses.devanagari:
ततः सरल तालाः च तिलका नक्त मालकाः |
प्रहृष्टाः तत्र सम्पेतुः कुब्जा भूता अथ वामनाः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sarala tālāḥ ca tilakā nakta mālakāḥ |
prahṛṣṭāḥ tatra sampetuḥ kubjā bhūtā atha vāmanāḥ
verses.translation: Then, dcodars palmyras and Tilaka trees along with Tamala trees transformed into hunch backs and dwarfs and joyfully arrived there.

verses.devanagari:
शिंशपा आमलकी जम्बूर् याः च अन्याः कानने लताः |
मालती मल्लिका जातिर्याश्चान्याः कानने लताः
प्रमदा विग्रहम् कृत्वा भरद्वाज आश्रमे अवसन् |
verses.iast:
śiṃśapā āmalakī jambūr yāḥ ca anyāḥ kānane latāḥ |
mālatī mallikā jātiryāścānyāḥ kānane latāḥ
pramadā vigraham kṛtvā bharadvāja āśrame avasan |
verses.translation: Shimshapas (Ashoka trees), Amalakis (Emblic myrobalan), Jambus (rose-apple trees), Malati, Mallika Jati and other creepers in the forest had been changed into dancing girls in the hermitage of Bharadwaja and they spoke as follows:

glosses.meaning: into the form of dancing girls

verses.devanagari:
सुराम् सुरापाः पिबत पायसम् च बुभुक्षिताः
मांसनि च सुमेध्यानि भक्ष्यन्ताम् यावद् इग्च्छथ
verses.iast:
surām surāpāḥ pibata pāyasam ca bubhukśitāḥ
māṃsani ca sumedhyāni bhakṣyantām yāvad igcchatha
verses.translation: "O, wine-bibbers! Drink the wine, however much you desire! O troops stricken with hunger! Let milk thickened iwth rice and the meats which are very much fresh, be eaten (as you will)"

glosses.meaning: you desire! bubhukSitaaH = O troops stricken with hunger! (Let)

verses.devanagari:
उत्साद्य स्नापयन्ति स्म नदी तीरेषु वल्गुषु |
अप्य् एकम् एकम् पुरुषम् प्रमदाः सत्प च अष्ट च
verses.iast:
utsādya snāpayanti sma nadī tīreṣu valguṣu |
apy ekam ekam puruṣam pramadāḥ satpa ca aṣṭa ca
verses.translation: Seven or eight young women bathed every single man on the beautiful river-banks, after massaging their body with oil.

glosses.meaning: after massaging their body with oil.

verses.devanagari:
सम्वहन्त्यः समापेतुर् नार्यो रुचिर लोचनाः |
परिमृज्य तथा न्यायम् पाययन्ति वर अन्गनाः
verses.iast:
samvahantyaḥ samāpetur nāryo rucira locanāḥ |
parimṛjya tathā nyāyam pāyayanti vara anganāḥ
verses.translation: Women with charming eyes came running and shampooed their limbs. Lovely women likewise wiped off the moisture on their body with towels and gave them beverages to drink, mutually sharing them among each other.

glosses.meaning: wiped off the moisture (on their body)
and gave them beverages to drink
mutually sharing them among each other.

verses.devanagari:
हयान् गजान् खरान् उष्ट्रामः तथैव सुरभेः सुतान् |
अभोजयन् वाहनपास्तेषां भोज्यं यथाविधि
verses.iast:
hayān gajān kharān uṣṭrāmḥ tathaiva surabheḥ sutān |
abhojayan vāhanapāsteṣāṃ bhojyaṃ yathāvidhi
verses.translation: The keepers of animals fed horses, elephants, donkeys, camels and bullocks (the offspring of Surabhi the divine cow) with their suitable feed.

verses.devanagari:
इक्षूमः च मधु जालामः च भोजयन्ति स्म वाहनान् |
इक्ष्वाकु वर योधानाम् चोदयन्तो महा बलाः
verses.iast:
ikṣūmḥ ca madhu jālāmḥ ca bhojayanti sma vāhanān |
ikṣvāku vara yodhānām codayanto mahā balāḥ
verses.translation: The animals, belonging to the exceedingly strong and illustrious warriors, the descendents of Ikshvaku, were fed with pieces of sugarcane and roasted grain soaked in honey, duly cajoling them to eat.

glosses.meaning: belonging to the illustrious warriors the descendents of Ikshvakus
and roasted grain mixed in honey

verses.devanagari:
न अश्व बन्धो अश्वम् आजानान् न गजम् कुन्जर ग्रहः |
मत्त प्रमत्त मुदिता चमूः सा तत्र सम्बभौ
verses.iast:
na aśva bandho aśvam ājānān na gajam kunjara grahaḥ |
matta pramatta muditā camūḥ sā tatra sambabhau
verses.translation: The groom did not recognise his horse. The elephant-keeper did not recognise his elephant. That army there appeared intoxicated, maddened and enraptured on that spot.

verses.devanagari:
तर्पिता सर्व कामैः ते रक्त चन्दन रूषिताः |
अप्सरो गण सम्युक्ताः सैन्या वाचम् उदैरयन्
verses.iast:
tarpitā sarva kāmaiḥ te rakta candana rūṣitāḥ |
apsaro gaṇa samyuktāḥ sainyā vācam udairayan
verses.translation: With all their desires gratified, their bodies anointed with red-sandal paste, and surrounded by a company of Apsaras, those soldiers uttered the following words.

glosses.meaning: and their bodies anointed with red-sandal paste
surrounded by a company of Apsaras

verses.devanagari:
न एव अयोध्याम् गमिष्यामो न गमिष्याम दण्डकान् |
कुशलम् भरतस्य अस्तु रामस्य अस्तु तथा सुखम्
verses.iast:
na eva ayodhyām gamiṣyāmo na gamiṣyāma daṇḍakān |
kuśalam bharatasya astu rāmasya astu tathā sukham
verses.translation: "We shall not go either to Ayodhya or to Dandaka forest. Let Bharata be well! Likewise, let Rama too be at east!"

verses.devanagari:
इति पादात योधाः च हस्त्य् अश्व आरोह बन्धकाः |
अनाथाः तम् विधिम् लब्ध्वा वाचम् एताम् उदैरयन्
verses.iast:
iti pādāta yodhāḥ ca hasty aśva āroha bandhakāḥ |
anāthāḥ tam vidhim labdhvā vācam etām udairayan
verses.translation: Having obtained that hospitality, the infantry, the cavalry as well as those mounted on elephants and their keepers too, no longer acknowledging their leaders, spoke the following words:

glosses.meaning: and cavalry as well as those mounted on elephants and their keepers too

verses.devanagari:
सम्प्रहृष्टा विनेदुः ते नराः तत्र सहस्रशः |
भरतस्य अनुयातारः स्वर्गे अयम् इति च अब्रुवन्
verses.iast:
samprahṛṣṭā vineduḥ te narāḥ tatra sahasraśaḥ |
bharatasya anuyātāraḥ svarge ayam iti ca abruvan
verses.translation: In the height of joy, those men in thousands there, the retinue of Bharata cried out, "This is verily of heaven!"

verses.devanagari:
नृत्यन्ति स्म हसन्तिस्म गायन्ति स्म च सैनिकाः |
समन्तात् परिधावन्ति माल्यो पेताः सहस्रशः
verses.iast:
nṛtyanti sma hasantisma gāyanti sma ca sainikāḥ |
samantāt paridhāvanti mālyo petāḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: The soldiers in thousands, wreathed in flowers danced, laughed, sang and ran hither and thither.

verses.devanagari:
ततो भुक्तवताम् तेषाम् तद् अन्नम् अमृत उपमम् |
दिव्यान् उद्वीक्ष्य भक्ष्यामः तान् अभवद् भक्षणे मतिः
verses.iast:
tato bhuktavatām teṣām tad annam amṛta upamam |
divyān udvīkṣya bhakṣyāmḥ tān abhavad bhakṣaṇe matiḥ
verses.translation: To those soldiers who had partaken that food which was as sweet as ambrosia, when they saw again those fresh dishes, there arose in them a desire to eat them again.

glosses.meaning: which was as sweet as ambrosia

verses.devanagari:
प्रेष्याः चेट्यः च वध्वः च बलस्थाः च अपि सर्वशः |
बभूवुः ते भृशम् तृप्ताः सर्वे च आहत वाससः
verses.iast:
preṣyāḥ ceṭyaḥ ca vadhvaḥ ca balasthāḥ ca api sarvaśaḥ |
babhūvuḥ te bhṛśam tṛptāḥ sarve ca āhata vāsasaḥ
verses.translation: Thousands of servants, slaves, youthful women and those in the army on every side, clad in new raiment, became very much contented.

verses.devanagari:
कुन्जराः च खर उष्ट्रः च गो अश्वाः च मृग पक्षिणः |
बभूवुः सुभृताः तत्र न अन्यो ह्य् अन्यम् अकल्पयत्
verses.iast:
kunjarāḥ ca khara uṣṭraḥ ca go aśvāḥ ca mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ |
babhūvuḥ subhṛtāḥ tatra na anyo hy anyam akalpayat
verses.translation: Elephants, donkeys, camels, bullocks, horses, animals and birds there were suitably well-fed. Hence, one did not afflict the other.

verses.devanagari:
न अशुक्ल वासाः तत्र आसीत् क्षुधितो मलिनो अपि वा |
रजसा ध्वस्त केशो वा नरः कश्चिद् अदृश्यत
verses.iast:
na aśukla vāsāḥ tatra āsīt kṣudhito malino api vā |
rajasā dhvasta keśo vā naraḥ kaścid adṛśyata
verses.translation: There was no one seen in soiled attire or hungry or unkept or with hair powdered with dust.

verses.devanagari:
आजैः च अपि च वाराहैर् निष्टान वर संचयैः |
फल निर्यूह संसिद्धैः सूपैर् गन्ध रस अन्वितैः
पुष्प ध्वजवतीः पूर्णाः शुक्लस्य अन्नस्य च अभितः |
ददृशुर् विस्मिताः तत्र नरा लौहीः सहस्रशः
verses.iast:
ājaiḥ ca api ca vārāhair niṣṭāna vara saṃcayaiḥ |
phala niryūha saṃsiddhaiḥ sūpair gandha rasa anvitaiḥ
puṣpa dhvajavatīḥ pūrṇāḥ śuklasya annasya ca abhitaḥ |
dadṛśur vismitāḥ tatra narā lauhīḥ sahasraśaḥ
verses.translation: Dishes of goat and boar with delicious sauces were there and condiments that were spicy, fragrant and succulent, cooked in fruit juices; vessels of rare metals filled with rice, decorated with flowers, were offered in thousands to those soldiers there. The soldiers saw them with wonder on all sides.

glosses.meaning: decorated with flowers shuklaamshcha annasya = of white rice

verses.devanagari:
बभूवुर् वन पार्श्वेषु कूपाः पायस कर्दमाः |
ताः च कामदुघा गावो द्रुमाः च आसन् मधुश्च्युतः
verses.iast:
babhūvur vana pārśveṣu kūpāḥ pāyasa kardamāḥ |
tāḥ ca kāmadughā gāvo drumāḥ ca āsan madhuścyutaḥ
verses.translation: The wells in various sides of the forest (surrounding Bharadwaja's hermitage) have their mud transformed into milk in which rice was cooked. The cows in the region were transformed into cows of plenty and the trees dripped honey.

glosses.meaning: in various sides of the kardamaaH = have their mud transformed into milk in which rice has been cooked with sugar

verses.devanagari:
वाप्यो मैरेय पूर्णाः च मृष्ट मांस चयैर् वृताः |
प्रतप्त पिठरैः च अपि मार्ग मायूर कौक्कुटैः
verses.iast:
vāpyo maireya pūrṇāḥ ca mṛṣṭa māṃsa cayair vṛtāḥ |
pratapta piṭharaiḥ ca api mārga māyūra kaukkuṭaiḥ
verses.translation: Some ponds there were endowed with full of wine and some were filled with assortment of various dressed meats pertaining to deer, peacocks and wild cocks; cooked in hot pans.

verses.devanagari:
पात्रीणाम् च सहस्राणि शात कुम्भमयानि च |
स्थाल्यः कुम्भ्यः करम्भ्यः च दधि पूर्णाः सुसंस्कृताः
यौवनस्थस्य गौरस्य कपित्थस्य सुगन्धिनः |
verses.iast:
pātrīṇām ca sahasrāṇi śāta kumbhamayāni ca |
sthālyaḥ kumbhyaḥ karambhyaḥ ca dadhi pūrṇāḥ susaṃskṛtāḥ
yauvanasthasya gaurasya kapitthasya sugandhinaḥ |
verses.translation: There were thousands of portable furnaces, lacs of culinary utensils ten crores of golden vessels, well-cleaned bowls filled with curds, small water-jars and wide-mouthed dishes.

verses.devanagari:
ह्रदाः पूर्णा रसालस्य दध्नः श्वेतस्य च अपरे |
बभूवुः पायसस्य अन्ते शर्करायाः च संचयाः
कल्कामः चूर्ण कषायामः च स्नानानि विविधानि च |
ददृशुर् भाजनस्थानि तीर्थेषु सरिताम् नराः
verses.iast:
hradāḥ pūrṇā rasālasya dadhnaḥ śvetasya ca apare |
babhūvuḥ pāyasasya ante śarkarāyāḥ ca saṃcayāḥ
kalkāmḥ cūrṇa kaṣāyāmḥ ca snānāni vividhāni ca |
dadṛśur bhājanasthāni tīrtheṣu saritām narāḥ
verses.translation: Lakes full of fresh curds, shining fragrant and in the colour of a wood-apple, curds mixed with sugar and spices, some other lakes filled with shite curds, some others filled with milk soaked in rice as well as sugar and some other lakes with a mixture of barley and sugar were formed.

glosses.meaning: of fresh (curds) gaurasya = shining sugandhinaH = fragrant
and also in the colour of a wood-apple
curds mixed with sugar and spices
of milk soaked in rice and sugar
and of heaps of mixture of barley-flour and sugar

verses.devanagari:
कल्कान् चूर्णकषायांश्च स्नानानि विविधानि च |
ददृशुर्भाजनस्थानि तीर्थेषु सरितां नराः
verses.iast:
kalkān cūrṇakaṣāyāṃśca snānāni vividhāni ca |
dadṛśurbhājanasthāni tīrtheṣu saritāṃ narāḥ
verses.translation: Those soldiers saw jellies, powders and syrups made of fruits and various kinds of accessories used in bathing, kept stored in vessels, on the banks of rivers.

verses.devanagari:
शुक्लान् अंशुमतः च अपि दन्त धावन संचयान् |
शुक्लामः चन्दन कल्कामः च समुद्गेषु अवतिष्ठतः
दर्पणान् परिमृष्टामः च वाससाम् च अपि संचयान् |
पादुक उपानहाम् चैव युग्मान् यत्र सहस्रशः
आन्जनीः कन्कतान् कूर्चामः चत्राणि च धनूम्षि च |
मर्म त्राणानि चित्राणि शयनान्य् आसनानि च
प्रतिपान ह्रदान् पूर्णान् खर उष्ट्र गज वाजिनाम् |
अवगाह्य सुतीर्थामः च ह्रदान् स उत्पल पुष्करान्
नील वैदूर्य वर्णामः च मृदून् यवस संचयान् |
निर्वाप अर्थम् पशूनाम् ते ददृशुः तत्र सर्वशः
verses.iast:
śuklān aṃśumataḥ ca api danta dhāvana saṃcayān |
śuklāmḥ candana kalkāmḥ ca samudgeṣu avatiṣṭhataḥ
darpaṇān parimṛṣṭāmḥ ca vāsasām ca api saṃcayān |
pāduka upānahām caiva yugmān yatra sahasraśaḥ
ānjanīḥ kankatān kūrcāmḥ catrāṇi ca dhanūmṣi ca |
marma trāṇāni citrāṇi śayanāny āsanāni ca
pratipāna hradān pūrṇān khara uṣṭra gaja vājinām |
avagāhya sutīrthāmḥ ca hradān sa utpala puṣkarān
nīla vaidūrya varṇāmḥ ca mṛdūn yavasa saṃcayān |
nirvāpa artham paśūnām te dadṛśuḥ tatra sarvaśaḥ
verses.translation: Those soldiers saw there heaps of twings used for cleaning the teeth with white brushes at their tips, white sandal pastes stored in caskets, polished mirrors, piles of clothes, thousands of pairs of shoes and sandals, caskets containing collyrium for the eyes; combs, brushed, raiments bows, protectors of vitals, strange couches and seats, drinking ponds for donkeys camels elephants and horses, lakes with good stairs for descent having water-lilies and lotuses with sky-blue colour, with clear water offering a comfortable bath and soft grasses having a colour of Nipa tree and of cat's eye gems useful for feeding animals.

glosses.meaning: heaps of twigs used for cleaning the teeth
caskets containing collyrium for the eyes
having colour of Nipa trees and of cat's eye gems.

verses.devanagari:
व्यस्मयन्त मनुष्यस्ते स्वप्नकल्फं तदद्भुतं |
दृष्ट्वाऽतिथ्यं कृतं तादृग्भरतस्य महार्षिणा
verses.iast:
vyasmayanta manuṣyaste svapnakalphaṃ tadadbhutaṃ |
dṛṣṭvā'tithyaṃ kṛtaṃ tādṛgbharatasya mahārṣiṇā
verses.translation: Seeing such a wonderful and dreamlike hospitality offered by the great sage Bharadwaja, all those men were surprised.

verses.devanagari:
इत्य् एवम् रममाणानाम् देवानाम् इव नन्दने |
भरद्वाज आश्रमे रम्ये सा रात्रिर् व्यत्यवर्तत
verses.iast:
ity evam ramamāṇānām devānām iva nandane |
bharadvāja āśrame ramye sā rātrir vyatyavartata
verses.translation: While they were enjoying thus in that charming hermitage of Bharadwaja, in the same manner as celestials enjoy the garden of Nandna, that night had elapsed.

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिजग्मुः च ता नद्यो गन्धर्वाः च यथा आगतम् |
भरद्वाजम् अनुज्नाप्य ताः च सर्वा वर अन्गनाः
verses.iast:
pratijagmuḥ ca tā nadyo gandharvāḥ ca yathā āgatam |
bharadvājam anujnāpya tāḥ ca sarvā vara anganāḥ
verses.translation: Having been permitted by Bharadwaja, those rivers, the celestial musicians and all those beautiful women went back by the same way they came.

glosses.meaning: by the same way they came.

verses.devanagari:
तथैव मत्ता मदिर उत्कटा नराः |
तथैव दिव्य अगुरु चन्दन उक्षिताः |
तथैव दिव्या विविधाः स्रग् उत्तमाः |
पृथक् प्रकीर्णा मनुजैः प्रमर्दिताः
verses.iast:
tathaiva mattā madira utkaṭā narāḥ |
tathaiva divya aguru candana ukṣitāḥ |
tathaiva divyā vividhāḥ srag uttamāḥ |
pṛthak prakīrṇā manujaiḥ pramarditāḥ
verses.translation: The soldiers, intoxicated with spirituous liquor, were likewise excited with joy. Likewise, the men were drenched in charming aloes and sandal paste. Various kinds of excellent and charming garlands were there, crushed and garlands were there, crushed and scattered at distances, likewise.

glosses.meaning: they were drenched in charming aloes and sandal paste
